title: SurgeCount: A Protocol-Guided Composition Harness for Bimanual Surgical Sponge Counting
summary: We present SurgeCount, a system for auditable robotic surgical sponge counting that composes learned skills under a written procedural protocol. Retained sponges cause preventable harm, and surgical teams count every sponge before closure to reduce that risk. The robot repeatedly isolates one deformable sponge from a tangled pile and places it in the next numbered counting-tray slot, requiring handling of occluded grasp threads while preserving step order. We train one subtask-conditioned policy on eleven short skills and learn when each skill ends. At each learned boundary, a stateful vision-language model selects the next skill from an operator-authored specification of step order, visual verification, and recovery. This creates temporal commitment to each subtask and enables failures to be recovered by recomposing existing skills rather than using a dedicated recovery policy. We evaluate five methods across 100 real-robot trials using 20 matched layouts. SurgeCount fills 47 of 60 ordered slots and completes 12 of 20 procedures, compared with 27 of 60 and 3 of 20 for the strongest of four end-to-end policies trained on the same data. Replacing the detailed protocol prompt with a minimal prompt reduces performance to 29 of 60 slots and 5 of 20 completed procedures. These results show that long-horizon performance depends not only on visuomotor capacity, but also on how learned skills are committed, verified, and composed. This tabletop proof of concept motivates further evaluation of protocol-guided robotic sponge counting in clinically representative settings.
tldr: SurgeCount is a surgical robotic system that counts deformable sponges by composing learned subtask skills under a written protocol, using a stateful vision-language model to select and verify each next skill and enabling failure recovery through skill recomposition rather than dedicated recovery policies.
tldr_zh: SurgeCount 是一种手术机器人纱布计数系统，通过书面协议组合已学习的子技能，利用有状态的视觉-语言模型选择并验证下一步技能，并通过重新组合技能而非专用恢复策略来处理失败。
summary_zh: 我们提出SurgeCount，一个用于可审计的机器人手术海绵清点系统，该系统在书面程序协议下组合学习技能。遗留海绵会造成可预防的伤害，手术团队在关腹前必须清点每块海绵以降低该风险。机器人反复从缠绕的海绵堆中分离出一块可变形海绵，并将其放入下一个编号的清点托盘槽位，这需要在保持步骤顺序的同时处理被遮挡的抓取线。我们在十一个短技能上训练一个子任务条件策略，并学习每个技能何时结束。在每个学习到的边界处，一个有状态视觉语言模型根据操作员编写的步骤顺序、视觉验证和恢复规范选择下一个技能。这实现了对每个子任务的时间承诺，并允许通过重新组合现有技能来恢复失败，而不是使用专门的恢复策略。我们在100次真实机器人试验中评估了五种方法，使用20个匹配布局。SurgeCount填满了60个有序槽位中的47个，并完成了20个程序中的12个，而在相同数据上训练的四种端到端策略中最强者分别只完成了60个中的27个和20个中的3个。将详细的协议提示替换为极简提示后，性能下降到60个槽位中的29个和20个程序中的5个。这些结果表明，长时程性能不仅取决于视觉运动能力，还取决于学习技能如何被承诺、验证和组合。这项桌面概念验证为在临床代表性环境中进一步评估协议引导的机器人海绵清点提供了动机。

title: MedUIGym: Evaluating and Training GUI Agents for Clinical Workflows
summary: Automating clinical workflows requires vision-language agents that can navigate dense graphical user interfaces (GUIs) in electronic health records (EHRs) and execute precise actions, yet many medical agents still rely on text or structured tool calls. In this work, we introduce MedUIGym, a scalable interactive environment comprising 15,739 tasks from 17 benchmark sources across six clinical task families for training and evaluating clinical GUI agents. In MedUIGym, agents perceive EHR states from screenshots and execute mouse-and-keyboard actions, as well as a paired native-tool interface over identical clinical data. The environment verifies both final answers and required clinical actions, and supports parallel trajectory collection for training. Benchmarking twelve vision-language models shows that current agents struggle across diverse clinical workflows, and simply increasing reasoning effort fails to yield consistent gains. Furthermore, MedUIGym supports offline learning from GUI trajectories and online reinforcement learning from task rewards. After training, both Qwen3.5 models perform better on in-domain clinical tasks and generalize to tasks from external sources. By unifying tasks from existing benchmarks, dual-interface evaluation, and GUI trajectory collection, MedUIGym provides a testbed for studying how vision-language agents complete clinical tasks through the EHR's graphical interface. Our project page is available at https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym.
tldr: Introduces MedUIGym, a large-scale interactive EHR GUI environment with 15,739 clinical tasks from 17 sources, supporting screenshot-based mouse/keyboard and native-tool interfaces, benchmark evaluation of 12 vision-language models, and offline/online reinforcement learning for training GUI agents. Results show current agents struggle across clinical workflows, while fine-tuned Qwen3.5 models improve in-domain performance and generalize to external tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出MedUIGym，一个大规模EHR图形界面交互环境，包含来自17个来源的15,739个临床任务，支持基于截图的鼠标键盘操作与原生工具双接口，评测12个视觉语言模型，并提供离线与在线强化学习训练。结果表明现有智能体在多样化临床工作流上表现不佳，但微调后的Qwen3.5模型在域内任务上表现提升，并具备跨源泛化能力。
summary_zh: 自动化临床工作流程需要能够导航电子健康记录（EHR）中密集图形用户界面（GUI）并执行精确操作的视觉语言智能体，然而许多医疗智能体仍依赖文本或结构化工具调用。在本工作中，我们引入了MedUIGym，一个可扩展的交互式环境，包含来自17个基准来源、涵盖六个临床任务族系的15,739个任务，用于训练和评估临床GUI智能体。在MedUIGym中，智能体从屏幕截图中感知EHR状态，并执行鼠标和键盘操作，同时还能通过配对的本地工具接口操作相同的临床数据。该环境既验证最终答案，也验证所需的临床操作，并支持并行轨迹收集以用于训练。对十二个视觉语言模型的基准测试表明，当前智能体在多样化的临床工作流程中表现不佳，且简单增加推理努力无法带来持续的性能提升。此外，MedUIGym支持从GUI轨迹进行离线学习，以及从任务奖励进行在线强化学习。经过训练后，两个Qwen3.5模型在域内临床任务上表现更好，并能泛化到外部来源的任务。通过统一现有基准的任务、双接口评估以及GUI轨迹收集，MedUIGym为研究视觉语言智能体如何通过EHR的图形界面完成临床任务提供了一个测试平台。我们的项目页面可在https://github.com/yitong-qiao/MedUIGym获取。

title: ColonoWorld: Camera-Controlled Full-Procedure Colonoscopy Video Generation
summary: Navigation systems in colonoscopy are advancing from guiding the endoscopist to steering the scope autonomously. Since an incorrect motion can injure the patient, developing and evaluating these systems calls for a world model of colonoscopy. Such a model must follow a commanded scope motion, keep the colon anatomy consistent, and show lesions and procedural events. Yet camera-controlled generators trained on general scenes lose the colon's structure under motion, and endoscopic generators offer no camera control. We present ColonoWorld, a colonoscopy world model conditioned on a camera trajectory and a coarse 3D tube of the colon, trained on in vivo videos. From a whole-colon tube, it generates a full cecum-to-rectum procedure, even for unseen colon shapes. It also places polyps, instruments, and irrigation at specified locations and times. ColonoWorld outperforms state-of-the-art video generators, reducing camera trajectory error by 32% and FVD by 29%. Our code and annotations will be released at https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld.
tldr: ColonoWorld is a colonoscopy world model that generates full-procedure videos conditioned on camera trajectories and a coarse 3D colon tube, enabling controllable generation of lesions, instruments, and irrigation for training and evaluating autonomous colonoscopy navigation systems.
tldr_zh: ColonoWorld是一种结肠镜世界模型，基于相机轨迹和粗略3D结肠管生成全流程视频，并可在指定位置和时间生成息肉、器械和冲洗效果，用于训练和评估自主结肠镜导航系统。
summary_zh: 结肠镜检查中的导航系统正从引导内镜医师向自主操控内镜方向发展。由于错误的运动可能伤害患者，开发和评估这些系统需要结肠镜检查的世界模型。这样的模型必须遵循指令性的内镜运动，保持结肠解剖结构的一致性，并显示病变和手术事件。然而，在通用场景上训练的相机控制生成器在运动下会丢失结肠结构，而内镜生成器则无法提供相机控制。我们提出了ColonoWorld，一种以相机轨迹和粗略的结肠三维管状结构为条件的结肠镜检查世界模型，并在体内视频上训练。从一个全结肠管状结构，它可以生成完整的从盲肠到直肠的手术过程，即使对于未见过的结肠形态也是如此。它还能在指定位置和时间放置息肉、器械和冲洗。ColonoWorld优于最先进的视频生成器，将相机轨迹误差降低了32%，FVD降低了29%。我们的代码和注释将在https://aidaslab.github.io/ColonoWorld发布。

title: Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures
summary: Machine learning models for clinical flow cytometry are usually evaluated on data drawn from their training distribution. In routine practice, however, acquisition conditions and reagents may change, potentially making predictions unreliable without warning. We propose a model agnostic criterion for prediction reliability based on a notion of distance from the training distribution: each patient sample is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, and its Jeffreys divergence to a reference fitted on the training data is estimated using Monte Carlo integration. We illustrate our approach on real-life shifted cohorts of acute myeloid leukaemia patients, using a classifier trained to predict NPM1 mutation status. First, we show graphically and statistically that pairwise divergences capture acquisition cohort structure. We then calibrate a rejection threshold on a subset of shifted cohort samples and evaluate it on held-out subjects. Across 20 runs, the misclassification rate of rejected samples was 2.5 times larger than for retained samples. These results suggest that input divergence can help identify unreliable predictions, providing a strong candidate component for abstention frameworks, along with quality control measures and classifier confidence.
tldr: The paper proposes a model-agnostic method to detect batch shift in clinical flow cytometry by representing patient samples as Gaussian mixture models and measuring Jeffreys divergence to a training reference, showing that rejected samples have higher misclassification rates in AML NPM1 status prediction.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种模型无关的方法，利用高斯混合模型表示患者样本，并通过与训练参考分布的Jeffreys散度来检测临床流式细胞术中的批次偏移；在AML NPM1状态预测中，被拒绝样本的误分类率更高。
summary_zh: 用于临床流式细胞术的机器学习模型通常基于其训练分布中的数据进行评估。然而，在常规实践中，采集条件和试剂可能发生变化，从而可能使预测在无预警的情况下变得不可靠。我们提出了一种与模型无关的预测可靠性判据，该判据基于与训练分布之间距离的概念：每个患者样本用高斯混合模型表示，并通过蒙特卡洛积分估计其与在训练数据上拟合的参考分布之间的杰弗里斯散度。我们在真实世界中发生偏移的急性髓系白血病患者队列上展示了该方法，使用一个训练用于预测NPM1突变状态的分类器。首先，我们从图形和统计上证明成对散度能够捕捉采集队列的结构。然后，我们在偏移队列样本的子集上校准拒绝阈值，并在留出受试者上进行评估。在20次运行中，被拒绝样本的误分类率是保留样本的2.5倍。这些结果表明，输入散度有助于识别不可靠的预测，为弃权框架连同质量控制措施和分类器置信度提供了一个强有力的候选组件。

title: Laya-IsoToken: Day-One Clinical Codebook Switching via Closed-Form Operator Compilation
summary: Healthcare systems periodically revise diagnostic and procedural classifications (ICD-9 to ICD-10/11), update hospital reimbursement groupers (MS-DRG), and deploy clinical coding across languages. Supervised coding networks bind clinical text encoders to fixed per-code classifier weights, forcing hospitals to re-annotate tens of thousands of records before switching codebooks, whereas standalone large language models incur high latency and hallucinate invalid codes. Here we show that day-one clinical codebook switching becomes feasible without target-labeled notes when local clinical evidence reading is decoupled from a strictly frozen multilingual concept space. Laya-IsoToken trains a clinical span reader once on source records with zero per-code classifier parameters, separating text evidence from historical disease prevalence. Given only public target code descriptions, closed-form matrix compilation aligns distributional shifts, compensates for paraphrased definitions, and deduplicates sibling codes in under three seconds, while a pre-deployment geometric residual routes unfamiliar concepts to offline language model verification. Across 32,804 MIMIC-IV ICD-9 discharges, Laya-IsoToken matches published supervised baselines (62.6% Micro-F1) while reducing active calibration error by 32%. Switched with zero target training notes to 13,783 unseen-patient ICD-10 discharges, MS-DRG groups, and multilingual cohorts, it outperforms biomedical dense retrievers, semantic crosswalks (+5.4 F1 points on ICD-10, paired $d_z = 0.49$, $p < 0.001$), and official US CMS equivalence mappings (+3.5 points, $p < 0.001$) at 9.4 ms per admission. Pairing this reader with an offline 31B verifier across 1,000 full discharge summaries lifts zero-training ICD-10 coding to 40.6% Micro-F1 (57.0% category F1, $d_z = 0.66$, $p < 0.001$) with 0.0% invalid code hallucinations.
tldr: Laya-IsoToken decouples clinical text encoding from per-code classifiers and uses closed-form matrix compilation to switch codebooks (e.g., ICD-9 to ICD-10, MS-DRG, multilingual) with zero target-labeled training notes, matching supervised baselines while reducing annotation cost and invalid-code hallucinations.
tldr_zh: Laya-IsoToken 将临床文本编码与逐代码分类器解耦，并通过闭式矩阵编译实现零目标标注样本的编码体系切换（如 ICD-9 到 ICD-10、MS-DRG、多语言），在匹配监督基线结果的同时降低标注成本并减少无效编码幻觉。
summary_zh: 医疗系统会定期修订诊断和程序分类（ICD-9到ICD-10/11），更新医院报销分组器（MS-DRG），并跨语言部署临床编码。有监督的编码网络将临床文本编码器与固定的逐代码分类器权重绑定，迫使医院在切换代码簿前重新标注数万份记录，而独立的大型语言模型则面临高延迟和生成无效代码的幻觉问题。在此，我们表明，当本地临床证据阅读与严格冻结的多语言概念空间解耦时，无需目标标签注释即可实现首日临床代码簿切换。Laya-IsoToken仅使用源记录训练一次临床跨度阅读器，且不包含任何逐代码分类器参数，从而将文本证据与历史疾病流行率分离。仅凭公开的目标代码描述，闭式矩阵编译即可在3秒内对齐分布偏移、补偿释义性定义差异并对兄弟代码去重，同时部署前的几何残差将不熟悉的概念路由至离线语言模型验证。在32,804例MIMIC-IV ICD-9出院记录中，Laya-IsoToken匹配已发表的有监督基线（62.6% Micro-F1），同时将主动校准误差降低32%。在零目标训练注释的情况下切换至13,783例未见患者ICD-10出院记录、MS-DRG分组及多语言队列，其性能优于生物医学稠密检索器、语义交叉映射（ICD-10上+5.4 F1点，配对\(d_z = 0.49\)，\(p < 0.001\)）以及美国CMS官方等价映射（+3.5点，\(p < 0.001\)），每次入院耗时9.4毫秒。将该阅读器与离线31B验证器配对，对1,000份完整出院小结进行推理，可将零训练ICD-10编码提升至40.6% Micro-F1（57.0%类别F1，\(d_z = 0.66\)，\(p < 0.001\)），且无效代码幻觉为0.0%。

title: WaDiS: Boundary-Preserving Diffusion Segmentation via Multi-Scale Wavelet Conditioning and Frequency-Aware Gating
summary: Diffusion models have shown strong potential in medical image segmentation due to their generative capabilities and robustness. However, existing methods often struggle to preserve fine anatomical boundaries and to retain multi-scale structural information due to the loss of spatial and frequency details during feature encoding, particularly in complex clinical imaging conditions. This work presents WaDiS, a wavelet-powered conditional latent diffusion framework for medical image segmentation that addresses these limitations through multi-scale wavelet conditioning and frequency-aware information filtering for boundary preservation. The model adopts a multi-scale wavelet conditioning encoder to retain rich structural features, leveraging its lossless nature to better preserve semantic priors critical to the diffusion process. In addition, a Frequency-Aware Gating Block (FAGB) is introduced into the skip connections of the diffusion U-Net, enabling adaptive spectral filtering and residual fusion to better emphasize boundary structures while reducing irrelevant content. To improve generalization across clinical domains, we adopt a structure-preserving color augmentation strategy during training. Specifically, global color statistics are transferred between samples in the LAB color space, allowing the model to decouple appearance from structure and focus more on anatomical shape rather than color bias. Experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that WaDiS consistently outperforms existing diffusion-based and conventional segmentation methods, with notable improvements in boundary accuracy, robustness to noise, and generalization under color variation. The code for this work will be made publicly available upon acceptance.
tldr: WaDiS is a wavelet-powered conditional latent diffusion framework for medical image segmentation that uses multi-scale wavelet conditioning and a frequency-aware gating block to preserve anatomical boundaries, improve noise robustness, and generalize across color variations, outperforming existing methods on five benchmark datasets.
tldr_zh: WaDiS 是一种基于小波的潜扩散医学图像分割框架，通过多尺度小波条件化与频率感知门控模块来保留解剖边界，提升噪声鲁棒性和跨颜色泛化能力，在五个基准数据集上优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 扩散模型凭借其生成能力和鲁棒性，在医学图像分割中展现出强大潜力。然而，现有方法在特征编码过程中常因空间和频率细节的丢失，难以保留精细的解剖边界及多尺度结构信息，尤其是在复杂的临床成像条件下。本文提出WaDiS，一种基于小波的条件下潜在扩散医学图像分割框架，通过多尺度小波条件化与频率感知信息过滤来解决上述局限性，实现边界保留。该模型采用多尺度小波条件编码器来保留丰富的结构特征，利用其无损特性更好地保持对扩散过程至关重要的语义先验。此外，在扩散U-Net的跳跃连接中引入频率感知门控块（FAGB），实现自适应频谱滤波与残差融合，从而在抑制无关内容的同时突出边界结构。为提升跨临床领域的泛化能力，我们在训练期间采用结构保持的颜色增强策略。具体而言，在LAB颜色空间中将全局颜色统计信息在样本间迁移，使模型能够将外观与结构解耦，更多关注解剖形状而非颜色偏差。在五个基准数据集上的实验表明，WaDiS始终优于现有的基于扩散的方法和传统分割方法，在边界准确性、噪声鲁棒性及颜色变化下的泛化能力方面均有显著提升。本工作代码将在录用后公开发布。
